detail.title: Are Businesses Scaling Back Hiring Due to AI?

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The swift advancement of artificial intelligence (AI) has sparked significant concern that this new technology will replace jobs and stifle hiring. To explore the effects of AI on employment, our August regional business surveys asked firms about their adoption of AI and if they had made any corresponding adjustments to their workforces. Businesses reported a notable increase in AI use over the past year, yet very few firms reported AI-induced layoffs. Indeed, for those already employed, our results indicate AI is more likely to result in retraining than job loss, similar to our findings from last year. That said, AI is influencing recruiting, with some firms scaling back hiring due to AI and some firms adding workers proficient in its use. Looking ahead, however, layoffs and reductions in hiring plans due to AI use are expected to increase, especially for workers with a college degree. 

To view post: https://libertystreeteconomics.newyorkfed.org/2025/09/are-businesses-scaling-back-hiring-due-to-ai/

title: Balancing Act or Policy Pitfall? The Effects of Central Bank Dual Mandates
affiliations: University of Essex - Department of Government and Portland State University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Balancing Act or Policy Pitfall? The Effects of Central Bank Dual Mandates
detail.abstract: Central banks are often tasked with steering economies toward goals that exceed price stability, but the consequences of broader mandates are understudied. This paper focuses the case of central banks that have the explicit mandate of promoting both price stability and full employment ("dual mandates"). We explain how dual mandate adoption generates institutional constraints that increase inflation without delivering meaningful gains in employment. We test our theory using original data on central bank mandates in 176 countries from 1985 to 2023. The empirical analysis addresses challenges of staggered adoption and treatment heterogeneity through entropy balancing, and generalized synthetic control approaches focusing on countries with clean adoption patterns. We find that dual mandate adoption raises inflation by about eight percentage points relative to inflation-only mandates, with effects persisting over time. In contrast, we do not find systematic long-term employment benefits. These results suggest that broader central bank mandates may weaken the effectiveness of monetary policy and increase the risk of politicization. This has implications for debates over institutional design, delegation, and the limits of technocratic governance.

detail.abstract:
Abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has substantially impacted various aspects of life, especially exacerbating the challenges faced by individuals with tuberculosis (TB). This research aimed to evaluate the health-related quality of life (HRQoL) of TB patients in Bangladesh during the first wave of the pandemic. A mixed-methods approach was utilized, combining both quantitative and qualitative data for a comprehensive analysis. The quantitative component employed two validated tools to assess HRQoL in TB patients receiving treatment at various health centers in Dhaka, Bangladesh, with 500 participants. Logistic regression analysis was performed to identify factors associated with HRQoL deterioration. The findings revealed that 47% of participants reported pain, and 35% experienced anxiety. Associations were observed between lower HRQoL and factors such as larger household sizes and greater distances from residences to health centers.

In the qualitative component, in-depth interviews highlighted significant challenges, including nutrition and financial instability, worsened during the pandemic. Participants noted that the Bangladeshi Government's efforts were insufficient in meeting their needs. The study emphasizes the importance of targeted relief initiatives that include nutritional and psychological support, especially for those with restricted mobility, limited access to healthcare, and increasing financial distress. This research calls for a comprehensive, multi-faceted approach to mitigate the impact of the pandemic on TB patients, addressing both immediate health-related issues and broader socio-economic concerns.

Keywords: Tuberculosis (TB), Health-Related Quality of Life (HRQoL), COVID-19, Logistic Regression, Bangladesh, Socio-Economic Impact, Healthcare Access, Nutritional Support, Mental Health, Pandemic, TB Care Barriers, Financial Hardship, Public Health Interventions.

title: Luxury for All: A Theory of In-kind Benefits and Inequality
affiliations: Paris School of Economics (PSE) and Paris School of Economics (PSE)

detail.title: Luxury for All: A Theory of In-kind Benefits and Inequality
detail.abstract: What is the optimal size of in-kind benefits, and should governments rely on subsidies or direct provision? In-kind benefits constitute over half of government expenditure in developed countries, yet most models treat them as an exogenous parameter. We develop a new theory of public spending based on two key features: government-provided goods are luxury goods, and they generate externalities that rise with equality. We show that these two conditions are necessary and sufficient for positive optimal public provision. Using empirical evidence, we demonstrate that they hold for most publicly provided goods, particularly health and education. We then embed these findings in a quantitative heterogeneousagent model with multiple goods consumed both privately and publicly. We find that the stronger the luxury nature of a good and the higher the inequality, the greater the optimal reliance on direct provision over subsidies. Finally, we show that optimal fiscal consolidation should focus more on reducing subsidies than cutting direct provision, especially for goods also consumed privately.

detail.abstract: This paper explores the limits of military power in ensuring national security, inspired by Psalm 20:7’s warning against overreliance on war instruments. Using historical examples like the Roman Empire and modern conflicts such as Vietnam and Afghanistan, it shows how military might alone cannot secure lasting peace or stability. The analysis highlights that strategic failures often stem from neglecting political, moral, and institutional foundations. The concept of “strategic humility” is advanced, calling for balanced security approaches that combine force with governance and societal cohesion. Ultimately, true national resilience depends on ethical leadership and strong institutions, not just superior weaponry.

detail.abstract:
This research paper is written by Xiaomeng Lu (Fudan University), Yoshio Nozawa (University of Toronto), and Zhaogang Song (Johns Hopkins University).

We document key facts about the inflation risk exposure of corporate bond returns within standard portfolio frameworks over the period 2004-2022. First, while inflation betas of standard bond excess returns (relative to T-bills) are, on average, negative, inflation betas of credit excess returns—measured relative to duration-matched Treasurys—are positive across nearly all bonds. Second, the cross-sectional variation in the inflation beta of corporate bond returns is primarily driven by that of credit excess returns, with higher-default-risk bonds exhibiting more pronounced positive inflation betas. Third, inflation beta affects future bond returns positively in the cross-section, and this effect is driven entirely by credit excess returns. Finally, firms with higher bond inflation betas also have higher stock inflation betas.

detail.abstract: With India's rapid digital transformation, cyber threats have emerged as a critical concern. Cyber insurance is an essential risk management tool for mitigating the financial and operational fallout from data breaches, ransomware, and digital fraud. However, the legal and regulatory frameworks governing this sector in India are still developing, presenting challenges in claim settlement and policy standardization. This paper examines the legal landscape of cyber insurance, focusing on the Information Technology Act, 2000, the recently enacted Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, and key judicial precedents. Using states like Bihar-where cybercrime has surged post-lockdown-as a case study, it highlights national deficiencies in cyber risk management. By comparing India's framework with international best practices, this paper proposes targeted legal and regulatory reforms to create a robust cyber insurance ecosystem that can support Digital India's ambitions.

detail.title: Language Input for Data Society (LIDS) Licensing Data for Collectives
detail.abstract: This paper explores the challenges of adapting intellectual property frameworks for the era of large language models (LLMs), with a focus on data sovereignty, community rights, and equitable benefit distribution. We examine the limitations of current approaches, such as fair use doctrine and Creative Commons licenses, which often fail to capture the nuanced, relational social norms that govern knowledge and data within communities, particularly those with low-resource languages or indigenous backgrounds. We propose a generative framework, Language Model Input for Data & Society (LIDS), a direct response to these challenges. Designed eith principles from evolutionary economics, indigenous data sovereignty and participatory design, LIDS is designed to be compatible with more community-centric licensing architectures. Our goal is to suggest a potential direction for developing agreements that might better operationalize complex social values and incentives. The legal-technical infrastructures of LIDS recognizes licensing of data as a collective and personal structure, while acknowledging its significant technical and social foundations and challenges.

detail.title: Are Auditors' CAM Disclosures Influenced by Client Proprietary Cost Concerns?
detail.abstract: Critical audit matters (CAMs) were introduced to enhance transparency in public company audits by providing engagement-specific insight into auditor judgments, yet early evidence shows many CAMs are highly standardized. Proprietary cost theory predicts that managers seek to limit transparency when disclosure risks revealing strategically sensitive information. We examine whether such concerns influence auditors' CAM reporting and find that clients with greater proprietary cost concerns receive CAMs that more closely conform to those of industry peers, according to both textual and categorical measures. Additionally, audit partners whose CAM reports deviate from industry norms experience a higher likelihood of voluntary turnover. Overall, our study reveals that client proprietary cost concerns extend beyond managerial disclosure decisions to influence auditors' communication, which may preclude the intended transparency benefits of expanded audit reporting.

publicationDetails.detailsText: ICAE Working Paper # 0225 | marzo, 2025

detail.abstract: Despite the significant economic impact associated with marital dissolution, divorce insurance remains conspicuously absent from contemporary risk management portfolios. This paper addresses this paradox by developing a multi-state, simulation-based actuarial framework that calculates risk-adjusted premiums incorporating critical demographic, economic, and behavioral variables-such as age at marriage, previous divorce history, and income disparities. Unlike previous failed attempts (notably WedLock in the USA), our model dynamically adjusts premiums to account explicitly for evolving marital and mortality risks, effectively mitigating adverse selection and moral hazard through mechanisms such as waiting periods and return-of-premium clauses. Simulation results indicate actuarially sound and market-viable premiums, highlighting divorce insurance's potential as a financial tool complementary to existing legal arrangements like prenuptial agreements. Our findings underscore the practical feasibility and invite further exploration into overcoming market acceptance barriers and regulatory challenges.

detail.title: Monetary Policy and Inequality: the Role of Household Heterogeneity and Imperfect Insurance
detail.abstract: This paper draws on empirical evidence that monetary policy affects the tightness of financial conditions and thus the number of financially-constrained households. I study the transmission of monetary policy in a tractable heterogeneous agent New Keynesian model with imperfect insurance, where the share of financially-constrained households endogenously adjusts to interest rate changes. Inequality between saver and hand-to-mouth households amplifies monetary policy effects on aggregate demand, with monopolistic rents enhancing and redistribution mitigating this amplification effect. The analysis has important policy implications since imperfect insurance and financially-constrained households can make monetary policy more powerful.

title: What Makes Scheduling "Responsible"? Evidence from 280 Million Shifts Across 20 Retailers
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania - Operations, Information and Decisions Department and University of Texas at Austin - Department of Information, Risk and Operations Management

detail.title: What Makes Scheduling "Responsible"? Evidence from 280 Million Shifts Across 20 Retailers
detail.abstract:
Problem Definition: What defines a “responsible” work schedule—and how does this definition vary across different operational and geographical contexts? Major retailers implement reforms based on the assumption that the same dimensions of schedule quality matter everywhere. At the same time, policymakers increasingly mandate scheduling practices (e.g., Fair Workweek laws). This paper examines which scheduling characteristics predict employee turnover across firms, regions, and worker groups.

Methodology/Results: We use administrative data covering 280 million shifts, 1.3 million employees, and 17,456 stores across 20 major U.S. retail chains. We construct over 100 schedule characteristics based on prior literature and apply LASSO variable selection to identify which metrics predict turnover. We estimate models separately across companies, U.S. states, zip-code socioeconomic groups, and employee subgroups (e.g., part-time, low-tenure, female). This analysis reveals that the set of predictive scheduling variables is highly context-dependent. For example, while advance notice is a significant predictor of retention at some firms, it has no predictive power at others. Quantifying this variation, we find over 80% of selected predictors are present in fewer than half of the models. Ultimately, no single scheduling characteristic consistently predicts turnover across all analyzed contexts.

Managerial Implications: These findings call into question the effectiveness of uniform scheduling mandates and highlight the limitations of “one-size-fits-all” strategies. For managers aiming to reduce turnover, the results underscore the importance of tailoring scheduling practices to the specific needs of their workforce and operational environment. For policymakers, our analysis reveals that rigid standards may misalign with local realities, inadvertently benefiting some workers while disadvantaging others. In a landscape where the very definition of a “responsible” schedule remains elusive, identifying which scheduling features matter most to employees is not a secondary concern—it is a foundational empirical task, and a necessary first step toward both sound policy design and effective workforce management.

AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"一刀切"日程质量定义的假设，证明日程质量的预测因素具有显著的情境依赖性

detail.abstract: Asymmetries play an important role in many macroeconomic models. We show that assumptions on household and firm expectations play a key role in determining the effects of these asymmetries on macroeconomic outcomes. If households and firms have perfect foresight and hence do not account for the possibility of future shocks, then the implied longer-run averages and distributions for unemployment and inflation can differ significantly from their rational expectations counterparts. We first derive this result analytically under either an asymmetric monetary policy rule or a nonlinear Phillips curve before numerically examining some of the key nonlinearities featured in the recent literature.

detail.title: Public Debt, iMPCs & Fiscal Policy Transmission
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the relationship between public debt and the effectiveness of fiscal policy, presenting evidence of an inverse relationship between government debt and fiscal multipliers. To explain the results, I develop and calibrate a HANK model tailored to the U.S. economy. The model reveals that higher public debt diminishes fiscal multipliers by making households less constrained. Theoretically, I show intertemporal marginal propensities to consume (iMPCs) are sufficient statistics of public debt, influencing fiscal multipliers. Decomposing changes in iMPCs into components driven by wealth distribution and the policy function, I find that the primary factor driving variations in iMPCs is the change in interest rates due to the variation of government bonds. This highlights a novel mechanism: even in the absence of fiscal limits or crowding out, large stocks of debt can weaken fiscal stimulus through their effect on household behavior.

title: The Role of Tourism in Economic Development: The Case of Nepal
affiliations: and San Diego State University

detail.title: The Role of Tourism in Economic Development: The Case of Nepal
detail.abstract: Tourism is widely recognized as a key driver of economic growth, particularly in developing economies where structural constraints limit industrialization. This study examines the role of tourism in Nepal's economic development, focusing on its contribution to GDP, employment, and foreign exchange earnings between 2000 and 2023. Using secondary data from the World Travel and Tourism Council (WTTC), Nepal Tourism Board (NTB), the Ministry of Finance, and the World Bank, the study applies descriptive statistics, correlation analysis, and comparative assessment to evaluate the tourism-development nexus. The results reveal that tourism has consistently accounted for 6-8% of Nepal's GDP, provided more than one million jobs, and emerged as a major source of foreign exchange. Strong positive correlations between tourist arrivals, receipts, and GDP growth confirm the relevance of the tourism-led growth hypothesis (TLGH) in the Nepalese context. However, the findings also highlight structural vulnerabilities: heavy dependence on international tourism has made the sector highly susceptible to external shocks such as the 2015 earthquake and the COVID-19 pandemic. The study concludes that Nepal must pursue diversification, sustainability, and inclusivity to maximize tourism's developmental potential while mitigating risks. These insights contribute to broader debates on tourism and development in emerging economies.

title: Border Trade and its Role in Achieving Economic Development between Sudan, Chad and Central Africa

detail.title: Border Trade and its Role in Achieving Economic Development between Sudan, Chad and Central Africa
detail.abstract: The study deals with the main topic of relations between these countries from a commercial perspective. The economic aspect in the relations of these countries is represented by the link of their trade with the national economy, as they are landlocked countries, and the trade axis forms the basis for future economic relations between these countries. The problem of the study was the lack of development of economic and trade relations between Sudan, Chad, and Central African countries, in addition to the lack of economic development in the common border areas between these countries, despite the existence of a large commercial exchange in border trade. The importance lies in its reading of the trends of commercial movement in the border areas, in light of the lack of interest from the governments of these countries and their policies that impede the development of their regions, which have been witnessing economic and social deterioration in relations and trade exchange. This can be avoided as the study aims to achieve economic development in the common border areas among these countries due to the availability of elements for economic advancement. The study relied on information that helps analyze the nature of the economic link between Sudan and the countries of Chad and Central Africa, and the areas in which these countries can cooperate to achieve economic development and secure a decent life for the peoples of the region. It is concluded that most of the proposed economic projects, such as railways, universities, airports, roads, border area lights, and common markets, remained theoretical on paper as they did not find their way to implementation on the ground due to political instability within these countries and their oscillation between hostility and cooperation, and the formation of joint committees. The study recommends the importance of paying more attention to this trade from the Sudanese side for its strategic benefit. It also recommends that the joint projects proposed for implementation should be completed. It also recommended the necessity of establishing huge commercial warehouses on the border strip, free markets, and economic integration in the field of commercial work related to the food industry.

title: The Quiet Recalibration of Society: AI, Identity, and the Subtle Erosion of Human Capacities
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Quiet Recalibration of Society: AI, Identity, and the Subtle Erosion of Human Capacities
detail.abstract: The accelerating integration of consumer artificial intelligence (AI) into daily life will be precipitating structural shifts in the very fabric of society. While public discourse often centres on speculative risks-such as conscious rebellion, catastrophic failure, or deliberate misusethe mentioned framings can obscure a subtler and more pervasive phenomenon: the capacity of non-sentient, rule-abiding AI systems to alter social norms and interpersonal dynamics through their very design, occurring in the present, rather than in a distant dystopian future. Such systems need not to contravene their programmed constraints to influence behaviour at scale; rather, the accruement of their effects. This paper conceptualises these effects as a "quiet recalibration", wherein sustained engagement with AI will incrementally redesign the structures, values, and practices that underlie our cultural matrix. Following a brief delineation of scope and limitations, the analysis proceeds in three parts: (I) a clarification of the underlying problem, mapping the mechanisms-such as identity shaping, and skill atrophy, through which consumer AI can erode interpersonal resilience and reinforce distorted self-perceptions; (II) a process-tracing of the pathways by which accessibility, cultural relativism, and commercial incentives can cumulatively yied functional aberrance; and (III) an anatomisation of persistent engagement dynamics, whereby the sustained availability, affective consistency, and absence of genuine social sanction in AI-user interaction facilitate the ongoing expression and rehearsal of harmful behaviours, diminishing the deterrent effect of natural interpersonal perimeters and consequences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出'静默重新校准'概念，探讨消费级AI如何通过设计而非违反规则来重塑社会规范、人际关系和文化结构，分析其通过身份塑造、技能退化等机制侵蚀人际韧性，并追踪可及性、文化相对主义和商业激励如何导致功能异常。
AI.research_question: 消费级人工智能系统如何通过其设计（而非违反规则）来重新校准社会规范、人际动态和文化结构？
AI.motivation: 公共讨论往往关注AI的推测性风险（如意识反叛、灾难性失败或故意滥用），但这些框架可能掩盖了一个更微妙且普遍的现象：非感知、遵守规则的AI系统通过其设计在当下（而非遥远的反乌托邦未来）改变社会规范和人际动态的能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 静默重新校准理论、社会规范演变理论、技术社会学框架
AI.method: 概念分析框架，包括三部分分析：(I)问题澄清和机制映射；(II)过程追踪路径分析；(III)持续参与动态解剖
AI.findings: 消费级AI通过身份塑造、技能退化等机制侵蚀人际韧性；可及性、文化相对主义和商业激励共同导致功能异常；持续可用性、情感一致性和缺乏真正社会制裁促进了有害行为的表达和演练。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出'静默重新校准'概念框架，为理解AI对社会规范的渐进影响提供理论工具，拓展了技术社会学的分析维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、技术开发者和公众提供识别和应对AI系统对社会规范潜在影响的实用框架，促进更负责任的技术设计和监管。

title: Lawbreaking as a Method of Competition
affiliations: Open Markets Institute

detail.title: Lawbreaking as a Method of Competition
detail.abstract:
On the surface, Uber, OpenAI, and Volkswagen appear to have little in common, but they are accused of relying on similar illegal competitive methods. Business competition is not a free-for-all in which firms can compete and triumph by hook or crook. Instead, market rivalry is a process structured by law, including sector-specific rules and laws of general application. Certain competitive strategies and tactics are proscribed by statutes, regulations, and common law. Firms may not compete by bombing their rivals’ facilities, bribing the employees of wholesale customers, or making false claims about their own goods.

In a range of industries, however, firms choose to compete by violating laws protecting consumers, workers, businesses, and the public and obtaining an unfair cost or other advantage over their rivals. Examples include Uber, which was accused of misclassifying its workers as independent contractors by multiple state attorneys general, OpenAI, which was charged with rampant copyright infringement by the New York Times, and Volkswagen, which lied about the tailpipe emissions of its cars to create a market for diesel passenger vehicles in the United States. Given its elastic antitrust authority, the Federal Trade Commission should prosecute such large-scale lawbreaking as an unfair method of competition and reinforce public policy.

AI.tldr: 本文主张企业通过违法手段获取竞争优势应被视为不公平竞争方法，联邦贸易委员会应利用其弹性反垄断权力起诉此类大规模违法行为。
AI.research_question: 企业通过违反保护消费者、工人、企业和公众的法律来获取竞争优势的行为是否应被视为不公平竞争方法？
AI.motivation: Uber、OpenAI和大众汽车等不同行业的公司被指控使用类似的非法竞争手段，但现有法律框架对这些行为的规制存在空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于竞争法的理论框架，特别是关于不公平竞争方法的定义和反垄断法的适用性。
AI.method: 案例分析法和法律解释法，通过分析Uber（工人分类）、OpenAI（版权侵权）和大众汽车（排放欺诈）等典型案例。
AI.findings: 企业通过违法手段（如错误分类工人、版权侵权、排放欺诈）获取成本或其他竞争优势，这些行为构成了不公平竞争方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了不公平竞争方法的理论内涵，将大规模违法行为纳入反垄断法的规制范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 为联邦贸易委员会提供执法依据，建议其利用弹性反垄断权力起诉此类违法行为，强化公共政策执行。

detail.title: Comparing Policy Pathways For 100% Medium- and Heavy- Duty Zero Emission Vehicle Sales in Canada: A Technical Analysis to Inform the Zero-Emission Vehicle Strategy
detail.abstract: Here, we assess the effectiveness of the different policies in achieving ZEV sales and GHG reduction goals in the MHDV sector. We find that under current policies in Canada the ZE MHDV market share falls well short of the 2030 and 2040 sales targets. ZEV purchase subsidies help increase ZE MHDV uptake in the near-term but fail to meaningfully boost adoption rates through mid-century. In contrast, a national ZEV sales standard is likely to be an effective policy for decarbonizing the MHDV sector. Our results show that a ZE MHDV sales standard achieves (or comes close to achieving) Canada’s ZE MHDV sales goals of 35% by 2030 and 100% by 2040, and reduces GHG emissions by 2050 (80% relative to business-as-usual), decreasing emissions from MHDVs from 34 Mt in 2020 to 10 Mt or less in 2050.   Further, a staggered ZEV sales standard design offers potential benefits compared to a standard with uniform ZEV sales requirements for all vehicle classes (as currently proposed in the ERP 2022).

AI.tldr: 评估加拿大中型和重型车辆(MHDV)部门不同政策对零排放车辆(ZEV)销售和温室气体减排目标的有效性，发现国家ZEV销售标准比购买补贴更有效

detail.title: Revisiting Geography and Sovereignty in the Digital Age

publicationDetails.detailsText: Northeastern University School of Law Research Paper No. 494
publicationDetails.journalName: Northeastern University School of Law Public Law & Legal Theory Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Fair housing advocates have already brought successful lawsuits challenging the use of property technology ("PropTech") where it has been found to perpetuate or replicate discriminatory practices in a range of contexts including the use of automated screening tools to evaluate prospective tenants. While substantive interventions in unlawful exclusions and differential treatment via PropTech are laudatory, this Article argues that these steps do not go far enough and moreover, that insufficient attention has been paid to the procedural implications of the federal Fair Housing Act ("FHA ") as a source of ex ante enforcement. 

The nation's first fair housing law, the 1866 Act, was ultimately deemed an appropriate exercise of congressional authority to eliminate the "badges and incidents of slavery" in Jones v. Alfred H. Mayer Co. This development, in conjunction with a deep-seated history of exclusionary municipal incorporation as well as other forms of disenfranchisement, indicates that the FHA may offer heightened protection for the participation of marginalized populations in formulating public policies and practices including the functions of digital technologies that shape access to housing opportunities in their communities. Rather than focus on PropTech itself this Article calls for fair housing advocates to center participation parity and principles of self-determination in their reform agendas as a more promising path for developing just cities in the digital age and beyond. To that end, an outline is offered for excavating the procedural justice dimensions in fair housing jurisprudence as a source of political empowerment for protected groups and their allies.

AI.tldr: 本文主张公平住房倡导者应超越对PropTech歧视性使用的诉讼挑战，转而关注《公平住房法》的程序正义维度，通过参与平等和自决原则来增强边缘群体的政治赋权。
AI.research_question: 如何通过《公平住房法》的程序正义维度，实现边缘群体在住房政策和技术应用中的参与平等和自决权利？
AI.motivation: 现有的PropTech诉讼虽然成功挑战了歧视性做法，但未能充分解决程序正义问题，缺乏对边缘群体参与住房政策制定的关注。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以1866年法案和Jones v. Alfred H. Mayer Co.案例为基础的法律理论，强调消除"奴隶制标志和影响"的国会权威，以及程序正义和自决原则。
AI.method: 法律文献分析和法理阐释，通过历史案例和法理推导来论证程序正义维度的重要性。
AI.findings: 《公平住房法》具有程序正义维度，能够为边缘群体提供参与住房政策制定的政治赋权，这比单纯的技术监管更有效。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将公平住房法理从实体正义扩展到程序正义的理论框架，强调参与平等和自决原则在数字时代的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公平住房倡导者提供了新的改革议程方向，建议通过程序正义机制增强边缘群体在住房技术政策制定中的参与权。

title: Chain Entrepreneurship and Social Networks Among Overseas Chinese: Historical Evidence from Indonesia, 1890–1940
affiliations: University Carlos III of Madrid

detail.title: Chain Entrepreneurship and Social Networks Among Overseas Chinese: Historical Evidence from Indonesia, 1890–1940
detail.abstract: This study examines whether a "chained effect" exists in ethnic Chinese entrepreneurship, using data on registered Chinese firms in Indonesia from 1890 to 1940, and investigates the factors influencing this effect. The findings confirm the presence of a chained effect in Chinese entrepreneurship in Indonesia, whereby entrepreneurial activity in earlier periods fosters entrepreneurship in subsequent periods. However, this chained entrepreneurship exhibits industry-specific heterogeneity. The effect is statistically significant in industries with lower barriers to entry, such as agriculture, trade, and services, but not in industries with higher barriers, such as mining, finance, and manufacturing. Additionally, I propose an original framework to assess the role of entrepreneurial capital. The empirical results reveal that Chinese entrepreneurship in Indonesia is influenced not only by individuals’ access to financial resources but also by the capital scale of existing firms, thereby enriching the academic understanding of entrepreneurial capital among ethnic Chinese. Furthermore, the analysis of factors shaping chained entrepreneurship among Chinese in Indonesia indicates that clan and township associations exert a positive moderating effect on the chained effect. In contrast, Chinese-operated newspapers, as a medium for public information, show no significant impact on chained Chinese entrepreneurship.

AI.tldr: 本研究确认了印尼华人创业中存在连锁效应，早期创业活动促进后期创业，但存在行业异质性。低门槛行业（农业、贸易、服务）效应显著，高门槛行业（矿业、金融、制造）不显著。提出了创业资本分析框架，发现金融资源获取和现有企业资本规模共同影响创业。宗乡组织正向调节连锁效应，华文报纸无显著影响。
AI.research_question: 印尼华人创业中是否存在连锁效应？影响这种连锁效应的因素有哪些？
AI.motivation: 探究华人创业活动的代际传递机制，理解创业资本在华人企业发展中的作用，以及社会组织对创业连锁效应的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创业连锁效应理论、创业资本理论、社会网络理论
AI.method: 使用1890-1940年印尼注册华人企业数据，进行实证分析，检验连锁效应存在性和行业异质性，构建创业资本分析框架。
AI.findings: 1）确认存在华人创业连锁效应；2）效应在低门槛行业显著，高门槛行业不显著；3）创业资本包括个人金融资源获取和现有企业资本规模；4）宗乡组织正向调节，华文报纸无影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了创业资本的新分析框架，丰富了华人创业理论；揭示了创业连锁效应的行业异质性；拓展了社会组织对创业影响的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 为华人企业家提供行业选择参考；为政策制定者提供促进创业的针对性建议；帮助社会组织更好地发挥创业支持作用。

title: Public Good Provision and Group Size: Elevator Retrofits
affiliations: Hebrew University of Jerusalem - Department of Economics and Independent

detail.title: Public Good Provision and Group Size: Elevator Retrofits
detail.abstract: We examine how group size affects the probability of provision of a discrete public good when all group members must agree to its provision and the manner of its funding. We derive empirically testable predictions to distinguish between models where provision depends on aggregate valuations, as in the first best and second best, and where provision depends on the minimum valuation, as might arise from social norms or strategic simplicity concerns. Our empirical application is to the presence of retrofitted elevators in old condominium buildings in Copenhagen, Denmark. Contrary to the prediction from the preference aggregating models, we find retrofitted elevators to be less common in buildings with many apartments. The rate of decline is consistent with fixed sharing models.

AI.tldr: 论文研究发现，在需要全体成员同意的公共品供给中，群体规模越大，电梯加装概率越低，这与偏好聚合模型预测相反，支持了固定分摊模型。
AI.research_question: 群体规模如何影响需要全体成员同意的离散公共品供给概率？
AI.motivation: 研究需要全体同意的公共品供给机制，区分偏好聚合模型和最低估值模型的实际适用性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共品供给理论，包括最优和次优的偏好聚合模型，以及基于社会规范或策略简化考虑的最低估值模型。
AI.method: 理论推导实证可检验预测，并以哥本哈根老旧公寓楼加装电梯为实证应用场景进行检验。

title: Who Commutes using Bus, Subway, Railroad, Cycling, and Walking in the U.S.?
affiliations: University of Arkansas Fort Smith, Korea Institute of Public Finance, , University of Arkansas Fort Smith and University of Arkansas Fort Smith

detail.title: Who Commutes using Bus, Subway, Railroad, Cycling, and Walking in the U.S.?
detail.abstract: In this study, we examine the time-trends in non-car commute modes from 2001-2019; we exclude the data following 2019 due to the idiosyncratic impact of the pandemic. In this study, we simultaneously examine income, age, and other demographic characteristics in the choice to select different modes of transit. We find that while bus transit has decreased, other forms of transit have increased over this period. Moreover, while there are income effects, it is not as simple as public transit is used more by the poor. Instead, the choice to use transit is dependent on mode, income, and density (among other factors). Over time, the impact of income has decreased in predictive power while density, and density-related characteristics like principal city, have increased in importance. Our results are in contradiction to some of the literature in this area and conventional wisdom. This leads to a different understanding of the barriers to higher public transit usage and what investments in transit could lead to higher ridership.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文研究了2001-2019年非汽车通勤方式的时间趋势，发现公交使用量下降但其他交通方式增长。收入影响逐渐减弱，而人口密度和城市特征的重要性提升，这与传统观点相反。
AI.research_question: 2001-2019年间非汽车通勤方式的时间趋势如何？收入、年龄和人口密度等因素如何影响交通方式选择？
AI.motivation: 重新考察交通方式选择的驱动因素，承议传统观点对公共交通使用的理解存在偏差，需要更加细致的分析来指导交通投资政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于交通方式选择理论，考虑人口统计学、城市经济学和运输经济学的多元因素影响模型。
AI.method: 时间序列分析（2001-2019年），多元因素统计模型，考虑收入、年龄、人口密度、城市特征等变量对不同交通方式选择的影响。
AI.findings: 1）公交使用量下降但其他交通方式增长 2）收入影响逐渐减弱 3）人口密度和城市特征的重要性提升 4）交通方式选择依赖于模式、收入和密度等多元因素
AI.theory_contributions: 挖掘了交通方式选择的时间动态演变规律，调成了传统以收入为中心的解释模型，强调了空间特征和城市结构的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府制定交通投资政策提供新的思路，指出应更多关注人口密度和城市规划，而非简单地投资公共交通运营。

title: When Will Countries Cooperate and When not? Quantifying The Importance of Similarities in Demand, Markups, And Geography in Trade Negotiations
affiliations: University of Florida, North Carolina State University, University of Florida - Department of Economics and University of Florida

detail.title: When Will Countries Cooperate and When not? Quantifying The Importance of Similarities in Demand, Markups, And Geography in Trade Negotiations
detail.abstract: When will countries cooperate within trade negotiations and under which underlying conditions? In this paper, we study trade wars and trade talks within a structural framework that allows for rich cross-country and sectoral heterogeneity in demand, productivity, and trade costs and in which countries specialize in sectors with heterogeneous markups and profits. We find that compared to perfect competition, especially heterogeneity in demand across countries generates a high degree of dispersion in optimal tariffs across countries, ranging from 0 to close to 100%. Further, the more unequal countries are in terms of demand elasticities, the higher will be the cooperative tariff that can be at most agreed on. Lastly, we find that groups of countries that specialize in high-markup goods find it easier to agree on tariff reductions than those producing low-markup varieties, suggesting a potential reason for why richer countries sign disproportionately more trade agreements than poorer countries do.

AI.tldr: 本文研究贸易谈判中各国合作的条件，发现在需求、生产力和贸易成本存在异质性的情况下，需求弹性差异导致各国最优关税差异巨大（0-100%）。需求弹性越不平等，可协商的合作关税越高。生产高利润率商品的国家更容易达成关税削减协议，这解释了富裕国家签署更多贸易协定的现象。
AI.research_question: 贸易谈判中各国何时会合作？在什么条件下会合作？
AI.motivation: 研究贸易战争和贸易谈判中的合作机制，理解各国在贸易政策制定中的行为差异和合作条件
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构性框架，考虑国家间和部门间的需求异质性、生产力异质性、贸易成本异质性，以及异质性加成和利润
AI.method: 结构性分析框架，模拟不同国家特征下的最优关税和合作条件
AI.findings: 1) 相比完全竞争，需求异质性导致各国最优关税差异巨大（0-100%）；2) 需求弹性越不平等，可协商的合作关税越高；3) 生产高利润率商品的国家更容易达成关税削减协议

title: Paraconsistent Logic for Predicting S&P and Ibovespa Futures Prices
affiliations: Instituto Federal de Santa Catarina and Pontifical Catholic University of Parana

detail.title: Paraconsistent Logic for Predicting S&P and Ibovespa Futures Prices
detail.abstract: This study presents a decision-making model based on paraconsistent annotated evidential logic Eτ (PAEL-Eτ), applied to Ibovespa and S&P 500 futures trading. The approach seeks to identify and resolve contradictions in technical analysis indicators, enhancing the reliability of investment decisions. Historical data from 1994 to 2023 are used to train and test these models, applying moving averagebased trading rules. The model generates daily forecasts based on the most recent past data, dividing the dataset into a training period for statistical analysis and a testing period for predictive evaluation. By estimating degrees of certainty and uncertainty, PAEL-Eτ systematically assesses the predictive reliability of each technical indicator. Results indicate that isolated indicators produce conflicting signals, confirming inherent inconsistencies. However, PAEL-Eτ mitigates these contradictions, filtering out unreliable signals. Despite short-term improvements in returns, statistical tests confirm no significant excess returns over the passive buy-and-hold strategy, reinforcing the weakform efficient market hypothesis (EMH). However, while the method does not consistently outperform the market, it provides a structured framework for handling conflicting information, with potential applications in automated trading and hybrid AI models.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于PAEL-Eτ逻辑构建投资决策模型，应用于Ibovespa和S&P 500期货交易，通过处理技术指标矛盾提升决策可靠性。结果显示虽无法持续超越市场，但提供了处理冲突信息的结构化框架。
AI.research_question: 如何利用PAEL-Eτ逻辑有效识别和解决技术分析指标中的矛盾，提升投资决策的可靠性？
AI.motivation: 技术分析指标经常产生相互矛盾的交易信号，传统方法难以系统处理这些矛盾，需要新的逻辑框架来提高投资决策的可靠性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于paraconsistent annotated evidential logic Eτ (PAEL-Eτ)理论框架，该逻辑能够处理不确定性和矛盾信息。
AI.method: 使用1994-2023年历史数据，应用移动平均交易规则，将数据集分为训练期和测试期，通过PAEL-Eτ估计确定性和不确定性程度来评估技术指标的预测可靠性。
AI.findings: 单独技术指标产生冲突信号，PAEL-Eτ能有效缓解矛盾并过滤不可靠信号；短期收益有所改善但统计检验显示无法显著超越买入持有策略，支持弱式有效市场假说。
AI.theory_contributions: 将paraconsistent逻辑应用于金融决策领域，提供了处理矛盾信息的新理论框架和方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为自动化交易和混合AI模型提供了结构化处理冲突信息的实用框架，尽管无法持续超越市场，但提升了决策的系统性和可靠性。

title: The Dark Side of Artificial Intelligence in Finance: Measuring the Negative Impacts of Blind AI Adoption on Investor Decision-Making
affiliations: The University of Lahore Islamabad Campus

detail.title: The Dark Side of Artificial Intelligence in Finance: Measuring the Negative Impacts of Blind AI Adoption on Investor Decision-Making
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has become an essential tool in modern finance, shaping how investors evaluate risks, manage portfolios, and respond to market fluctuations. While its efficiency, speed, and predictive power have been widely celebrated, the blind adoption of AI presents significant challenges to investor decision-making. This study explores the negative impacts of over-reliance on AI-driven systems, particularly focusing on the risks of technical failures, panic-driven behaviors, biases embedded in algorithms, and the illusion of rationality that may distort investor perceptions. Using data collected from a survey of 500 investors and analyzed through SPSS regression models, the findings reveal that reliance on AI significantly shapes investor decisions, while concerns about technical failure remain the most dominant factor influencing trust and comparative judgment. Surprisingly, perceptions of "reasonable" AI reduce investor confidence, suggesting skepticism toward overly human-like rationality in automated systems. The results highlight the paradox of AI adoption in finance: while investors increasingly depend on its predictive capabilities, they remain deeply concerned about hidden risks, lack of transparency, and potential behavioral distortions. This research contributes to the growing body of literature on the dark side of AI by emphasizing the need for safeguards, regulatory oversight, and investor education. By identifying the adverse consequences of blind AI adoption, this study underscores the importance of balanced integration-where technological innovation is matched with ethical governance and critical awareness.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了金融领域过度依赖AI的负面影响，包括技术故障风险、恐慌驱动行为、算法偏见和理性幻觉等问题。通过对500名投资者的调查和SPSS回归分析，发现AI依赖显著影响投资决策，技术故障担忧是主要影响因素，而"合理"AI反而降低投资者信心。研究强调了AI采用悖论，呼吁平衡技术创新与伦理治理。
AI.research_question: 过度依赖AI驱动系统对投资者决策产生哪些负面影响？
AI.motivation: AI在金融领域的广泛应用虽然提高了效率和预测能力，但盲目采用AI给投资者决策带来了重大挑战，需要研究其负面影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学、技术接受模型、风险管理理论
AI.method: 通过对500名投资者的问卷调查，使用SPSS回归模型进行数据分析
AI.findings: 1) AI依赖显著影响投资决策；2) 技术故障担忧是最主要的影响因素；3) "合理"AI反而降低投资者信心；4) 投资者既依赖AI预测能力又担忧隐藏风险
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了AI负面影响的文献，揭示了AI采用悖论，为行为金融学提供新视角
AI.practical_contributions: 强调需要保障措施、监管监督和投资者教育，提倡技术创新与伦理治理的平衡整合

title: Dynamic Connectedness among Gold, Green Finance, and Cryptocurrencies: Evidence from TVP-VAR and AI-Based Portfolio Strategies
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Dynamic Connectedness among Gold, Green Finance, and Cryptocurrencies: Evidence from TVP-VAR and AI-Based Portfolio Strategies
detail.abstract: This paper analyzes the return and volatility connectedness among gold, green finance, and cryptocurrencies in response to the COVID-19 pandemic and the Russo-Ukrainian war. To capture spillover dynamics, we employ a Time-Varying Parameter Vector Autoregression (TVP-VAR) model from January 2018 to November 2024. Then, we apply K-means clustering to conditional volatilities in order to detect distinct market regimes. After that, we designed a dynamically optimized portfolio using artificial neural networks (ANN). Results show that during the pandemic, BTC, ETH, BNB, ADA, and the S&P Global Clean Energy index acted as net transmitters of return shocks, while DOGE, XRP, gold, and green indices were as net receivers. In the Russo-Ukrainian war period, BTC, ETH, BNB, and ADA remained net transmitters, while the S&P Global Clean Energy shifted to a net receiver role. Volatility dynamics were relatively stable, with major cryptocurrencies consistently transmitting shocks to gold, DOGE, XRP, and green indices. K-MEANS clustering revealed three distinct market regimes. Finally, the ANN-optimized portfolio outperforms both fully cryptocurrency-based and hybrid strategies in terms of cumulative and risk-adjusted returns. These findings demonstrate the importance of integrating connectedness analysis, regime detection, and AI-based optimization to strengthen portfolio resilience during crises.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了黄金、绿色金融和加密货币在COVID-19大流行和俄乌战争期间的收益和波动性联动关系，通过TVP-VAR模型、K-means聚类和人工神经网络构建了动态优化投资组合，发现AI优化策略在危机期间表现更优。
AI.research_question: 黄金、绿色金融和加密货币在全球危机期间的收益和波动性联动关系如何；如何构建更具弹性的投资组合来应对市场波动？
AI.motivation: 全球危机（如COVID-19大流行和俄乌战争）对金融市场造成重大冲击，需要研究不同资产类别间的联动关系和投资策略的效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间变参数向量自回归模型(TVP-VAR)、K-means聚类算法、人工神经网络(ANN)投资组合优化理论。
AI.method: 使用TVP-VAR模型分析2018年1月至2024年11月数据，应用K-means聚类识别市场注制，然后设计ANN动态优化投资组合。
AI.findings: 大流行期间，主要加密货币作为净冲击传播者，黄金和绿色指数为净接收者；战争期间，绿色指数转为净接收者；发现三个市场注制；ANN优化策略表现最优。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了危机期间资产联动性的时间变化视角，将波动性聚类与AI优化结合的新研究框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了基于市场注制和AI优化的动态资产配置策略，提高危机期间的投资组合弹性。

title: Impacts of Industry 4.0 Technologies on Pension Systems: A Scoping Review
affiliations: University of Cassino - Department of Economics and University of Valencia - Department of Financial Economics

detail.title: Impacts of Industry 4.0 Technologies on Pension Systems: A Scoping Review
detail.abstract: Industry 4.0 (I4.0) technologies are reshaping administrative operations and labor markets with significant implications for pension systems. This scoping review maps how I4.0 affects pensions through both direct administrative/operational channels and indirect labor-market transformations across institutional settings. Following PRISMA-ScR and a PCC framework, we screened English-language records and excluded grey literature. Data were charted on technology type, technology's impact, study design, and reported outcomes. We included 88 studies. Evidence indicates that artificial intelligence/machine learning, robotic process automation, and advanced analytics primarily affect contribution collection, claims adjudication, fraud detection, and customer service; blockchain/distributed ledger technology (DLT) and smart contracts are positioned for keeping, portability, and governance; and cloud computing underpins digitalization at scale. Indirect channels operate via automation-induced job displacement, skill shifts, and platform work, with downstream effects on contribution bases, density, and equity. We introduce a direct/indirect/combined impact taxonomy and conduct keyword cooccurrence mapping to reveal conceptual bridges (e.g., governance-risk, sustainabilitylabor). Main challenges include data quality and interoperability, algorithmic transparency and bias, legacy information technology constraints, cybersecurity, and regulatory capacity. From this synthesis, we propose a time-phased policy roadmap and a targeted research agenda to address measurement gaps and under-represented contexts. To our knowledge, this is the first scoping review to integrate direct administrative/operational impacts with indirect labor-market channels within a unified framework for pensions, providing a structured evidence base for policy and supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文通过范围综述系统分析了工业4.0技术对养老金系统的直接影响（行政运营）和间接影响（劳动力市场转型），提出了直接/间接/综合影响分类法，并制定了分阶段政策路线图和研究议程。
AI.research_question: 工业4.0技术如何通过直接行政运营渠道和间接劳动力市场转型渠道影响养老金系统？
AI.motivation: 工业4.0技术正在重塑行政运营和劳动力市场，对养老金系统产生重大影响，但缺乏系统性的整合分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于PRISMA-ScR和PCC框架的范围综述方法，构建直接/间接/综合影响分类法。
AI.method: 遵循PRISMA-ScR指南的系统性范围综述，筛选了88项英文研究，排除灰色文献，对技术类型、影响、研究设计和结果进行数据提取。
AI.findings: AI/ML、RPA和高级分析主要影响缴费征收、理赔裁定、欺诈检测和客户服务；区块链/DLT和智能合约适用于记录保存、可移植性和治理；云计算支撑规模化数字化。间接渠道通过自动化导致的岗位替代、技能转变和平台工作影响缴费基数、密度和公平性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将直接行政运营影响与间接劳动力市场渠道整合到统一的养老金分析框架中，提出了概念桥梁（如治理-风险、可持续性-劳动力）。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了分阶段政策路线图和针对性研究议程，为政策制定和监管提供了结构化证据基础，解决了数据质量、算法透明度、遗留IT系统等主要挑战。

title: From Brussels to Bangkok: How Investment Funds Transmit Financial Spillovers

authors.last_name: Institute for Monetary and Financial Research

affiliations: (HKIMR)

detail.title: From Brussels to Bangkok: How Investment Funds Transmit Financial Spillovers

publicationDetails.detailsText: Hong Kong Institute for Monetary and Financial Research (HKIMR) Research Paper No. 15/2025
publicationDetails.journalName: Hong Kong Institute for Monetary & Financial Research (HKIMR) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This research paper is written by Pablo Anaya Longaric (European Central Bank), Katharina Cera (European Central Bank), Georgios Georgiadis (European Central Bank), and Christoph Kaufmann (European Central Bank).

We explore whether investment funds transmit spillovers from local shocks to financial markets in other economies. As a laboratory we consider shocks to financial-market beliefs about the probability of a rare, euro-related disaster and their spillovers to Asian sovereign debt markets. Given their geographic distance from and relatively limited macroeconomic exposure to the euro area, these markets are an ideal testing ground a priori stacking the deck against finding evidence for investment funds transmitting spillovers from euro disaster risk shocks. Analyzing proprietary security-level holdings data over the period from 2014 to 2023, we find that investment funds strongly shed Asian sovereign debt in response to euro disaster risk shocks. Markets with greater investment-fund presence exhibit considerably larger price spillovers. The main driver of this sell-off is the need to generate liquidity to meet investor redemption demands rather than portfolio rebalancing. Especially market liquidity determines which sovereign debt investment funds shed. Taken together, our findings suggest that due to a flighty investor base investment funds are powerful transmitters of spillovers from local shocks across global financial markets.

AI.tldr: 投资基金会将本地冲击（如欧元区灾难风险）传导至其他经济体金融市场，特别是亚洲主权债市场。基金为应对投资者赎回需求而抛售资产，而非投资组合再平衡，是主要传导机制。
AI.research_question: 投资基金会否将本地冲击传导至其他经济体的金融市场？
AI.motivation: 探讨投资基金在全球金融市场中作为冲击传导机制的作用，特别是在地理距离较远、宏观经济关联度较低的市场中是否存在显著溢出效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融市场溢出效应理论、投资基金流动性管理理论和灾难风险定价理论。
AI.method: 使用2014-2023年专有的证券级别持仓数据，以欧元区灾难风险冲击作为实验室环境，分析对亚洲主权债市场的影响。
AI.findings: 投资基金强烈抛售亚洲主权债以应对欧元灾难风险冲击；投资基金参与度高的市场表现出更大的价格溢出效应；主要驱动因素是满足投资者赎回需求的流动性需求而非投资组合再平衡；市场流动性决定基金抛售哪些主权债。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实投资基金作为强大的冲击传导机制，揭示了基于不稳定投资者基础的流动性需求是主要传导渠道，丰富了金融市场溢出效应理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供关于投资基金跨境风险传导的重要证据，有助于制定更有效的金融稳定政策和风险管理措施。

title: Forecasting Federal Funds Rates with AI: LSTM, GRU, and Large Language Model Approaches
affiliations: ASEAN+3 Macroeconomic Research (AMRO), ASEAN+3 Macroeconomic Research (AMRO) and ASEAN+3 Macroeconomic Research (AMRO)

detail.title: Forecasting Federal Funds Rates with AI: LSTM, GRU, and Large Language Model Approaches
detail.abstract: Forecasting the U.S. federal funds rate is important since it impacts global financial conditions, and in turn the real economy. This study examines whether AI models could forecast policy rates accurately by inferring the implicit decision rules the U.S. Federal Open Markets Committee (FOMC) follows when setting the policy rate. We examine two recurrent neural networks (RNNs), LSTM and GRU, and a large zero-shot language model (LLM) capable of combining numerical economic data and interpreting qualitative information. The forecasting performance of the three models is good, especially during the zero lower bound and early COVID 19 periods. The policy rules implied from the RNN models suggest that the FOMC might have been overly accommodative during the COVID-19 pandemic. Since 2020, the models suggest a deviation from prior monetary policy patterns, with the FOMC adjusting rates less frequently than predicted by the model-implied policy rules. These findings suggest that incorporating AI insights could enhance our understanding of and ability to predict future Fed rate decisions.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨AI模型是否能够通过推断美联储FOMC设定政策利率的隐含决策规则来准确预测联邦基金利率。研究发现RNN模型和大型语言模型在预测方面表现良好，特别是在零利率下限和COVID-19早期期间。模型暗示FOMC在疫情期间可能过于宽松，且2020年后出现了与先前货币政策模式的偏离。
AI.research_question: AI模型是否能够通过推断美联储FOMC设定政策利率的隐含决策规则来准确预测美国联邦基金利率？
AI.motivation: 预测美国联邦基金利率对全球金融状况和实体经济具有重要影响，因此需要探索AI模型在此领域的应用潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于货币政策规则理论和机器学习预测理论，特别是循环神经网络（RNN）和大型语言模型在时间序列预测中的应用。
AI.method: 使用两种循环神经网络（LSTM和GRU）以及一个大型零样本语言模型，结合数值经济数据和定性信息进行联邦基金利率预测。
AI.findings: 三种模型预测性能良好，特别是在零利率下限和COVID-19早期期间。RNN模型暗示FOMC在疫情期间可能过于宽松，2020年后利率调整频率低于模型预测。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了AI模型能够有效推断货币政策决策规则，为理解央行决策机制提供了新的方法论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果表明整合AI见解可以增强对美联储利率决策的理解和预测能力，为金融市场参与者和政策制定者提供有价值的预测工具。

title: Comparative Analysis of Indicator-Based Urban Sustainability Assessment Frameworks
affiliations: Environment Europe Foundation and Independent

detail.title: Comparative Analysis of Indicator-Based Urban Sustainability Assessment Frameworks
detail.abstract: Sustainability indicators are widely used to assess city sustainability. Based on published articles and peer reviews, the aims of this systematic review is threefold: (1) to determine which indicator categories (sustainability pillars) are commonly applied to assess city sustainability, (2) to define what limitations exist with regard to indicator categories, and (3) to assess which governance indicators are currently applied. It is proposed that the lack of consensus on and commitment to a clear definition of sustainable development – particularly regarding the number of ‘pillars’ of sustainability and the question of whether a three- or four-pillar approach is preferable – leads to ambiguity and inconsistency in the application of sustainability indicators to assess cities. The representation of governance in sustainable city indicator frameworks is found to be lacking, despite the vital role that it plays in ensuring the sustainable city concept. To move forward with indicator-based city sustainability assessments the following recommendations are made: (1) a clear definition of city sustainable development should be decided upon; (2) this definition should take into account the ‘fourth pillar’ of sustainable development, i.e. governance; and (3) further research should be conducted into the definition of governance itself and into the method through which it can be represented by indicators.

AI.tldr: 这篇系统综述论文分析了城市可持续性评估中指标应用的现状，发现由于缺乏对可持续发展定义的共识（特别是三支柱还是四支柱框架），导致指标应用存在模糊性和不一致性。研究发现治理指标在可持续城市指标框架中代表性不足，建议明确城市可持续发展定义、纳入治理作为第四支柱，并深入研究治理的定义和指标化方法。
AI.research_question: 城市可持续性评估中常用的指标类别（可持续性支柱）是什么？现有指标类别存在哪些局限性？当前应用了哪些治理指标？
AI.motivation: 可持续性指标被广泛用于评估城市可持续性，但缺乏对可持续发展定义的共识导致指标应用存在模糊性和不一致性，特别是治理支柱的代表性不足问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于可持续性支柱理论框架（三支柱或四支柱方法），探讨环境、经济、社会以及治理等维度的指标应用。
AI.method: 系统综述方法，基于已发表文章和同行评审进行分析。
AI.findings: 1) 缺乏对可持续发展定义的共识导致指标应用模糊不一致；2) 治理指标在可持续城市指标框架中代表性不足；3) 需要明确城市可持续发展定义并纳入治理作为第四支柱。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将治理作为可持续发展第四支柱的理论框架，为城市可持续性评估提供了更完整的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和城市管理者提供了具体的建议：明确城市可持续发展定义、纳入治理指标、深入研究治理的指标化方法，以改进城市可持续性评估实践。

title: Pro-Competition Regulation: Lessons from the Telecoms Sector for Digital Platforms
affiliations: London School of Economics and Independent

detail.title: Pro-Competition Regulation: Lessons from the Telecoms Sector for Digital Platforms
detail.abstract: This paper addresses different ways of addressing the control of market power by major global digital platforms. It does so by comparing the approach taken in the USA, which involves reliance on competition law (including breakups), and the approach in the European Union, where sector-specific legislation in the form of the 2022 Digital Markets Act is employed,. The question is framed as a choice between competition law and a mode of pro-competition regulation in the form of mandated sharing, which requires the dominant firm to share some of its assets with competitors. The assumed goals of the process are to protect direct customers of the dominant firm, and to prevent it from extending its power up or down the value chain (or ecosystem) by self-preference. The main discussion is preceded by a comparison of the parallel case of telecommunications in the period from 1980, comparing the USA's breakup strategy with EU's mandated sharing or unbundling one. The paper then examines the competition law cases currently in progress in the USA, which, if proven, may use breakup or equivalent as a chief remedy. While recognising the uncertainties of the current situation, it suggests that this approach will be protracted, incomplete, and of uncertain outcome. It argues that in the EU a combination of the institutional framework for enforcement and mandated sharing or interoperability available under the DMA is likely to be more productive in achieving the stated objectives.

AI.method: 比较分析法，通过对比美国（竞争法）和欧盟（DMA立法）的方法，并参考1980年代电信行业的平行案例。

detail.title: Outcomes Following Termination of Social Security Disability Insurance Benefits
detail.abstract: This article examines the experiences of Social Security Disability Insurance (DI) disabled-worker beneficiaries following termination of benefits due to medical improvement or work. The authors explore earnings, DI reentitlement, and Supplemental Security Income eligibility in the 5- and 10-year periods after benefit termination and find that beneficiaries whose benefits were terminated because of work tend to have higher post-termination earnings and greater likelihood of DI reentitlement than those whose benefits were terminated because of medical improvement. The authors also investigate the association between beneficiary characteristics and post-termination outcomes, finding that age, entitlement duration, the likelihood of medical improvement, and certain diagnoses—especially psychotic disorders, intellectual disorders, neoplasms, and injuries—correlated with earnings levels and the likelihood of disability program reeligibility in the years following termination.

title: Estimating Bottleneck Power: A Network Analysis of Competition in the Early PC Industry
affiliations: University College London - Institute for Innovation and Public Purpose

detail.title: Estimating Bottleneck Power: A Network Analysis of Competition in the Early PC Industry
detail.abstract: While digital-era competition increasingly unfolds across webs of complementary products rather than within markets, analytical tools to quantify these effects remain underdeveloped. This paper addresses this gap by introducing a new method to measure bottleneck power and estimating its impact on value capture in the early Personal Computer (PC) industry. We build a unique dataset mapping the complementarities between PC products from 1981 to 1987 and apply network analysis to investigate the determinants of firms' value capture. To quantify bottleneck power, we propose a bespoke centrality measure that captures the extent to which each product serves as an indispensable intermediary within a dense cluster of the network. Our findings show that openness, defined as the share of complementarities with external firms, does not increase value capture. Similarly, merely controlling a bottleneck has no significant effect, while reliance on external bottlenecks has a clear negative effect. By contrast, firms with higher average bottleneck power are associated with greater value capture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种测量瓶颈权力的新方法，并分析了其在早期PC行业中对价值获取的影响。研究发现开放性和单纯控制瓶颈对价值获取无显著影响，而平均瓶颈权力与价值获取正相关。

detail.title: Inequality of Opportunity, Social Mobility, and Life Satisfaction: A Comparative Analysis of Western Balkans and European Welfare Regimes
detail.abstract: This study investigates how inequality of opportunity (IOp) and perceived social mobility (PSM) affect life satisfaction (LSat) across seven European welfare regime clusters, including a novel classification of the Western Balkans as a distinct post-communist regime. Drawing on the 2016 European Quality of Life Survey, we apply a two-level linear mixed-effects model to estimate income decompositions and psychological outcomes, accounting for the nested structure of individuals within cities and countries. The analysis employs both Gini and mean log deviation (MLD) estimators to capture IOp and validate robustness. Findings confirm that circumstances beyond individual control—such as socio-economic background, rural residence, and housing deprivation—exert significant effects on income, especially in regimes marked by institutional fragmentation. IOp negatively predicts life satisfaction in all post-communist and Southern European regimes, while this association is statistically absent in liberal and socialdemocratic clusters, highlighting the buffering role of redistributive institutions. Crucially, PSM emerges as a strong and consistent positive predictor of well-being across all regimes, suggesting that belief in future mobility can partially offset the psychological toll of structural disadvantage. The Western Balkans exhibit the strongest negative association between IOp and LSat and the highest contextual variance, reinforcing the compounding effects of weak institutions and constrained opportunity. By integrating objective inequality with subjective mobility perceptions, this study contributes to a growing literature linking fairness, trust, and well-being. The findings offer actionable implications for inequality monitoring and welfare reform, especially in transition economies where optimism and opportunity remain structurally misaligned. Efforts to reduce IOp and foster credible mobility pathways are essential not only for economic cohesion but for enhancing subjective well-being and democratic resilience in Europe’s most vulnerable welfare regimes.

detail.abstract:
This research paper is written by Eric Girardin (Aix-Marseille University) and Roselyne Joyeux (Macquarie University).

The Hong Kong residential market, which plays an important role in the local economy and financial system, is often presented as being especially prone to bubbles, given its combination of often specific institutional, regulatory and economic features. To detect bubbles in the Hong Kong residential housing market with monthly data over a thirty-year period (1993-2023) we implement a two-step strategy. We first decompose the price-to-rent ratio into fundamental and non-fundamental components using a recent, simplified, approach introduced by Shi and Phillips (2023). This method relies on the estimation of a single-equation reduced-form model using data on house price and rent indices. Due to the persistence and endogeneity of the explanatory variables, the model is estimated with the IVX-AR instrumental variable method. We then test whether the sufficient condition for a bubble, i.e. a mildly explosive root, was met by the non-fundamental component of the price-to-rent ratio. We find that bubbles are clustered both in the late 1990s, and in the late 2010s, when the price-to-rent ratio was above fundamentals. We also document that a stochastic factor was not responsible for mildly explosive periods.

detail.abstract:
Background: In contrast to other observational study designs, quasi-experimental approaches (e.g., difference-indifferences , interrupted time series, regression discontinuity, instrumental variable, synthetic control) account for some sources of unmeasured confounding and can estimate causal effects under weaker assumptions. Studies which apply quasi-experimental approaches have increased in popularity in recent decades, therefore investigators conducting systematic reviews of observational studies, particularly in biomedical, public health, or epidemiologic content areas, must be prepared to encounter and appropriately assess these approaches. However, there currently exists limited guidance for investigators conducting systematic reviews including quasi-experimental studies.

Objective: Our objective is to describe key methodological challenges and considerations for systematic reviews including quasi-experimental studies, with attention to current recommendations and approaches which have been applied in previous reviews.

Recommendations: We recommend that individuals conducting systematic reviews including quasi-experimental studies: 1) do not use search strategies which require specific terms for study design for identification, given inconsistent nomenclature and poor database indexing for quasiexperimental studies; 2) ensure that their review team includes several individuals with expertise in quasi-experimental designs for screening and risk of bias assessment in duplicate; 3) use an approach to risk of bias assessment which is sufficiently granular to identify studies most likely to report unbiased estimates of causal effects (e.g., modified Risk Of Bias In Non-randomised Studies-of Interventions [ROBINS-I]); and 4) consider the implications of varied estimands when interpreting estimates from different quasi-experimental designs. Researchers may also consider restricting systematic review inclusion to quasi-experimental studies for feasibility when addressing research questions with large bodies of literature. However, restricting review inclusion to quasi-experimental studies does not reduce the initial volume of search results when study design terms are not applied, and additional screening time and expertise is needed to identify eligible designs. Reviews which do not restrict inclusion to quasi-experimental studies are preferred, as well-designed studies using a variety of methodological approaches may be more credible than a quasi-experiment which violates causal assumptions.

detail.title: Government Loan-Backed Securities (GLBS) for Long-Term Deficit Financing
detail.abstract: This white paper explores the concept of Government Loan-Backed Securities (GLBS) as a mechanism for financing state and federal government deficits through long-term bank loans (30-50 years) that are pooled, securitized, and sold to investors by a syndicate of banks. The structure can be enhanced through Federal Reserve involvement to lower borrowing costs and improve market liquidity. Cost modeling suggests that, with securitization and potential Fed guarantees, GLBS could approach or even match the cost of long-term government bonds while diversifying funding sources.

detail.abstract: Patron Traffic Counters (PTC) integrated with RFID technology are transforming academic library management by enabling precise, real-time analytics. This case study examines the implementation of RFID-enabled PTC systems across Chandigarh University's Management and CSE libraries-high-traffic hubs serving 15,000+ users. Analysis of pre/postimplementation data (2023-25), it can be seen significant operational improvements: the accuracy of manual footfall counting jumped from 73-79% to an impressive 95-98%, gate transaction times were slashed by 66% (from 35 seconds to just 12 seconds), and user satisfaction with the entry process increased by 20-25%. The methodology used a triangulation approach that combined manual registers, PTC reports, and RFID gate data, along with annual user surveys. The results highlight the efficiencies brought about by PTC: a footfall growth of 30-48%, better staff scheduling during busy times, and flexible space reallocation. Some challenges were faced, such as initial sensor calibration issues and privacy concerns, but these were addressed through system upgrades and anonymization protocols. This study confirms that integrating RFID with PTC is a scalable solution for academic libraries, showing nearly 50% space-utilization efficiency gains and enabling data-driven decision-making. Looking ahead, there are plans to implement AI-powered predictive analytics across the other 14 libraries at CU.

detail.title: Aligning AI Decision-Making with Organizational Values: Synthetic Experiments in a Multi-Stakeholder Utility Framework

keywords: Strategic management Aligning AI Decision-Making with Organizational Values

detail.abstract: Organizations are increasingly integrating artificial intelligence (AI)-driven synthetic agents into their decision-making processes, yet aligning AI outputs with organizational values remains an unresolved challenge. This paper introduces a theoretically grounded, multi-stakeholder utility framework to experimentally test methods of embedding organizational values into AI managerial decisions. Using synthetic data generated within a stylized economic environment, we examine the alignment of AI preferences with organizational objectives modeled through a firm-specific utility function. Our approach enables precise measurement on the degree to which AI decisions reflect the prioritized trade-offs among shareholders, employees, consumers, and society at large. Leveraging this synthetic dataset, we experimentally measure the model's native (contextfree) preferences, and test two alignment mechanisms: implicit framing (prompting industry-specific context with firm-specific objectives), and explicit alignment (AI models directly fine-tuned to a parameterized utility function). Results from three experimental studies indicate that explicitly aligning synthetic agents to a clearly structured multi-stakeholder utility function significantly improves decision consistency, accountability toward stakeholders, and alignment with organizational objectives. We discuss implications for strategic management, AI governance, and organizational theory, highlighting practical strategies for embedding ethical and stakeholder-aligned considerations into AI systems.

detail.abstract: Between 1870 and 1930, hundreds of women served as judges in the United States. While a small number compared to the men who served, these pathbreaking officials were particularly visible and influential in women's efforts to secure political rights and advance in the legal profession. Women's progress in obtaining judgeships developed in a regional pattern, with women in the Midwest and West able to secure earlier and broader jurisdiction positions than their counterparts in the Northeast and South. Seeking access to the judiciary, women in conservative states made gendered arguments about women's supposed superiority in overseeing cases involving women, children, and families. Some demonstrated women's skill in handling juvenile and family matters through service as the country's first probation officers, a step that supported women's selection as judges in juvenile and family courts. Regardless of location or type of court, women judges attracted significant attention because they seemed to embody the promise and perils of women's increasing political and professional power. Yet since most served in local trial courts, nearly all are forgotten today. This Article recovers the stories of these overlooked trailblazers, offering the most comprehensive account of the obstacles they faced and the strategies they deployed to join the country's judicial benches.

detail.title: The Importance of Information Channels for Cross-border M&A: An Analysis of Google’s Arrival and Departure from China
detail.abstract: This study investigates the impact of Google’s initiation into and withdrawal from China on M&A performance. The empirical findings indicate that when Google arrived in China, cross-border M&A deals experienced a significantly higher cumulative abnormal return (CAR) on the announcement date compared with domestic counterparts. However, when Google departed China, the CARs declined for cross-border M&A announcements compared with domestic ones. These findings are robust to PSM-DID analysis, placebo tests, and dynamic trend tests. Channel tests show that Google provided incremental international information for acquirers and market participants, especially retail investors. Finally, we examine the real effect of Google on the efficiency of M&A transactions and find that Google impacts completion time, completion probability for cross-border deals, and premiums paid to international targets.

detail.title: The Problem of Business Evil
detail.abstract: We explain why ethical decision makers who care about others through other-regarding preferences can nevertheless be the cause of corporate scandals, such as Barings, Société Générale (both rogue trading), Purdue Pharma (opioid addiction), WorldCom, and Bernie Madoff (accounting/financial fraud). We show that all decision makers, however ethical, have an in-too-deep threshold. If private knowledge that the innovation they have introduced is harmful arrives after a threshold time then the decision maker will knowingly choose to continue to harm others - until publicly caught. We show the result is robust to patents and to limited liability. We show fines can make concealment of evil worse. And we show that ethical agents are more likely to lose innovation races, but punitive punishments after public revelation can mitigate the problem.

detail.title: Production Networks and Industrial Policy Design: A General Equilibrium Framework with Endogenous Link Formation
detail.abstract: This paper develops a general equilibrium framework to analyze how industrial policies shape production network structures through firm-level input adoption decisions. A policymaker can influence these decisions using tax wedges on input purchases. To enhance the model, we present a structured review of recent literature that intersects industrial policy and production network theory. We simulate our network formation model grounded on a general equilibrium economy for different tax-based policy scenarios such as "No intervention", "Static centrality targeting", and "Temporal centrality targeting". We analyze the effect of different policy targeting rules on network topology and aggregate economic outcomes. The model offers a tractable and flexible tool for evaluating industrial policy design in economies where inter-firm linkages are critical to macroeconomic performance.

detail.title: Country Banks and the Panic of 1825
detail.abstract: The Panic of 1825 was one of the world’s first international financial crises. We document how this crisis spread from London banks to England’s real economy. England’s correspondent banking network propagated trouble in sovereign debt markets to small banks outside of London and ultimately to non-financial firms. Using exogenous variation in district-level exposure to the crisis, we show that bank failures led to a substantial number of bankruptcies among non-financial firms. We explore two potential mechanisms by which the financial system affected the real economy: a fall in aggregate demand and a credit supply shock.

detail.abstract: In humanitarian and development work, traditional Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability, and Learning (MEAL) systems often operate in a fragmented manner, failing to reflect the complex, adaptive nature of the real-world systems they aim to serve. detail.abstract: This study deals primarily with the effectiveness of the Land Bank of Philippines as a Depository Bank of Makati Branch in specific organization and bank operations management. This paper provides baseline data in aid of policy formulation to enhance the bank operations management that offers new motivation towards a policy that effectively addresses and solves the bank operations management. This study used the quantitative descriptive method. Thirteen (13) bank personnel and 64 barangays elected chairman, including the appointed treasurer with direct access to the bank transaction regarding the funds of the barangays in Makati City, were purposely taken as research respondents. It was found that no significant difference exists in the assessment of the respondents in organization and bank operations management when grouped according to age, gender, and educational attainment. The mean evaluation of the respondents in the organization and bank operations management with the variables mentioned revealed effectiveness, and the grand mean and the composite mean are within the mean range of 3.50-4.49, interpreted as effective. This implies that the variables mentioned are directly performed to the standard of the bank. It is recommended that the bank look into the deposits of the barangay funds as it is mandated by law to secure the funds of the barangay in the form of deposits and withdrawals.

detail.title: Motivated by Karma
detail.abstract: We conduct an experiment to examine how karmic reasoning-the belief that good deeds lead to favourable outcomes-affects belief formation in unrelated chance events. We motivate our design by observations from the China Family Panel Studies, which show that respondents who donated in the past 12 months are more likely to make risky choices. To investigate this further, we design a controlled laboratory experiment to evaluate the impact of real charitable donations on subjects' beliefs about winning an even-chance lottery. Our results reveal that beliefs about winning increase with the amount donated, but this effect is significant only among those who voluntarily donated and more sensitive to karmic believes. This study underscores the role of karmic reasoning in shaping beliefs, contributing to the broader understanding of wishful thinking and motivated beliefs.

detail.abstract:
This research paper is written by Alessandro Rebucci (Johns Hopkins University), Sinem Yagmur Toraman (Johns Hopkins University), and Giorgio Valente (Hong Kong Institute for Monetary and Financial Research).

Long-run uncovered interest rate parity (LRUIP) tends to hold for G10 currencies (Chinn & Meredith, 2004; Lustig, Stathopoulos, & Verdelhan, 2019). Focusing on the ten most freely floating emerging market currencies (EM10), we show that UIP does not hold even in the long run for emerging markets (EMs). However, when UIP regressions are augmented with measures of credit risk, LRUIP cannot be rejected statistically for these currencies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，虽然G10货币的长期无抛补利率平价(LRUIP)成立，但新兴市场十大货币(EM10)即使在长期也不满足UIP。然而，当在UIP回归中加入信用风险指标后，这些货币的LRUIP在统计上无法被拒绝。
AI.research_question: 新兴市场货币是否满足长期无抛补利率平价(LRUIP)？信用风险是否解释了新兴市场货币的UIP偏离？
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明G10货币的LRUIP成立，但新兴市场货币的UIP表现尚未得到充分研究，特别是信用风险在其中的作用。

AI.method: 对十大新兴市场货币(EM10)进行UIP回归分析，并在回归中加入信用风险指标进行扩展分析

detail.abstract: Colombia's prolonged conflict has made the country one of the most affected by forced internal displacement (FID) in the world. This study examines the impact of the FARC's 2014 unilateral and permanent ceasefire on FID. We use a difference-in-differences strategy that exploits the timing of the ceasefire and the pre-conflict distribution of FARC presence across municipalities. Results show a substantial reduction in severe displacement episodes in affected areas, with effects that emerged gradually and persisted over time. These findings highlight the importance of stability and the effective implementation of peace agreements in mitigating FID and its far-reaching consequences.
